links.comparator_used: Same evaluators' ratings of cards before versus after seeing stage-5 (S5) automated LLM feedback (single-arm two-phase design); human expert evaluation served as the reference for the text-level PASS cards
links.outcome: Blocking-error detection and technical accuracy and educational quality scores after S5 critic feedback; evaluation-level false-negative rate of text-level PASS cards
links.effect: S5 feedback associated with blocking-error flags rising from 39 to 54 evaluation-level observations (McNemar p = 0.003) and lower technical accuracy and educational quality scores (both p < 0.001). Evaluation-level FNR for blocking errors among PASS cards was 1.00% (95% CI 0.50-1.78%), above the pre-specified 0.3% threshold.
links.tradeoff: The single-arm design cannot separate useful cueing from anchoring or re-review effects. The pipeline's own PASS gate missed blocking errors above the safety threshold, so the authors do not support fully automated deployment.
links.quote: S5 feedback was associated with increased blocking-error flags (39-54 evaluation-level observations, McNemar p = 0.003) and decreased technical accuracy and educational quality scores (both p < 0.001).
